## What produces the gain

The new factory completes coordinate centers early, loads the own-block
correction directly into an invertible output basis, and delivers selected
cross-block sums by reading their two existing face copies. The same partition
in both tetrahedra lets 56 selected packet sums be omitted. This gives 504
helpers while preserving every arbitrary source/helper input under cleanup.

Seventy-two compatible line gauges and eighty exact shared-donor pivots give
152 width-eight residuals and 352 width-nine residuals. The real prefix cost
is included. Then 248 legal frame promotions in delivery body B coalesce paid
climbs, saving exactly `96 log(64/3)` in local entropy fee. They change no scalar
coefficient, operation order, cut, entrance or cleanup.

The decisive global step reallocates those residuals across actual idle
families. All 36,288 roles have literal complete owners, explicit spectators
and legal busy windows. The final global profile comes from this assignment,
including all 7,968 paid remainders. The failed simple slot-shrinking experiment
and the fractional LP price contribute no claimed gain.

Read `proof/LOCAL-CONSTRUCTION.md`, `proof/DELIVERY-AND-COALESCING.md`, and
`proof/GLOBAL-HOSTING.md` for the precise arguments and their scope.

## Fast offline replay

Python 3.11 or later, assertions enabled, standard library only by default:

```bash
python -B verify_fast.py --work /absolute/path/to/new-output
```

The output directory must be new and outside this package. The default checks
the frozen changed scalar word on all columns, rebuilds the global owner maps,
independently audits the controller and paid profile, recounts the new finite
invoice, and runs both exact moment engines and all 47 outer inequalities.
It reuses the byte-pinned completed phase/data/unchanged-bit dependencies.
There is no network call, optimizer, predecessor cold replay, or all-edge phase
replay in this default command. The packaged default entry point completed
successfully in **19.8 seconds** in this environment; its per-stage receipt is
`evidence/FAST-REPLAY.json`.

Optional `--rebuild-local` also reconstructs the packet factory and frozen
rational entrance selection, without rerunning discovery. Optional
`--delta-phases` freshly lowers only the 1,680 changed phase edges and requires
NumPy; 1,242 matching edges and all 224 endpoint adapters still reuse the
pinned PR523 cache. The changed-edge check completed in about 27 seconds in
this work and is not repeated by default.

`EXPECTED.json` is the concise numerical contract. `evidence/audit/EXACT-ASSEMBLY.json`
contains the strict rational signs, six bootstrap levels and 47 inequalities.
`MANIFEST.json` pins all supplied bytes. Generated audit timing fields may vary;
raw-constructor diagnostic floating fees are not proof data. Optional local
reconstruction is compared by the exact canonical word rather than those
diagnostics or gzip container headers.

fresh physical owner/controller audit. The new invoice and two-engine outer
assembly each completed in about a second. The global prefix is `225 < 512`
bits; the physical row coefficient is `16467 < 20161`.

The inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-basis realization,
normalized Lemma A realization, restored-row, precision/tape and analytic
transfer interfaces remain conditional. This is a finite conditional global
witness; no new unconditional theorem or Lean formalization is asserted.
